findings.statement: Native sys_enter callback still depends on emitted named peer symbols/BTF; KCFI with both lookup results absent returns -ENOENT before native register. Fixed KSU uses generated callback type checker. Prior owner proved actual DDK checker red/green but only evaluated migration; production replacement is not implemented.
findings.currentCohortImpact: Conditional on actual named peer symbol emission/lookup; this review has not loaded the target module.
findings.action: Root decides current-source completion scope; implement generated native callback type check while preserving real CFI/register errno, or explicitly retain this unclosed support condition. Do not delete CFI blindly.

findings.statement: PREEMPT_RT is rejected by both runtime producer and marker_open. Existing marker_update acquires sleepable RT tasklist rwlock while raw_spinlock/probe atomic context is active; removing the two gates alone is wrong. Prior owner explicitly delivered analysis, not production synchronous RCU/consumer fix.
findings.currentCohortImpact: Non-RT release may be built without this branch; not evidence of RT/all-configuration support.
findings.action: Keep accurate support scope; a complete no-extra-gates closure needs actual consumer synchronization fix and regression before deleting RT veto.

claimCatalogContract: schema1 exact native catalog for legacy claim route; schema2 generic component catalog for unpaired init_boot patching; overlapping sources same generation.
conclusion: Known TaskProfile native peer-symbol qualification and RT consumer support remain source limits. Other reviewed fixes have source/host receipts, not final release/device acceptance. Issue4 final delivery must be collected. This review does not assert universal support or a new release.
